_meta.description: Registry of Digital Asset Treasury (DAT) companies and their disclosed BTC holdings.
_meta.methodology: Holdings are company-disclosed figures (10-K/10-Q/8-K filings, exchange filings, press releases, treasury dashboards) as of the as_of date. Nothing here is independently verified unless known_addresses is non-empty and on-chain balances have been reconciled. Market caps are intentionally null unless supplied at analysis time — DATproof does not report numbers it cannot source.
_meta.inclusion_rule: Companies whose own disclosed bitcoin holdings rank among the largest corporate treasuries at the snapshot date, plus any public company that publishes verifiable proof of its corporate bitcoin. Entities that made no disclosure of their own are recorded as attributed and are never assigned a letter grade. Additions and removals are recorded in the repository's commit history.
